scope: Sanitized technical incident archive; no usable node credentials.

conclusion.observed_issue: Missing downstream data, repeated TCP retransmission, and congestion window reduction.
conclusion.mitigation: Separate VMess AES-128-GCM over mKCP/UDP with verified TLS 1.3.
conclusion.measurement_limit: Short tests on one client and one VPS; not a sustained or universal throughput guarantee.

tcp_header_observation.interpretation_note: SACK event ratio and overlapping sequence bytes are not link packet-loss-rate measurements.

udp_echo.interpretation_note: Requests reached the server application; missing echoes narrow this sample to the return direction, not a particular network device.

security_checks.wrong_certificate_name_evidence: Core reported an x509 identity validation error, in addition to curl failing.

mobile_status.android_v2rayng: not_tested; KCP seed/finalmask compatibility depends on client/core version

excluded_samples.reason: Temporary server watchdog exited before later requests; not interpreted as a network failure.
